title: Secure first confirmed adopting partner
context: The project's success bar requires plans to be actually taught by real teachers or accepted by real repositories — not just authored. The outreach task (task-007) opens the first threads; this M1 task must close one: securing a confirmed adopting partner who agrees to use contributed plans, documents the adoption mechanism, and allows affected tasks to be updated to verifiedNeed: true with a named requestor. Without a confirmed partner, every task in the project remains verifiedNeed: false and no plan can be counted as delivered.
objective: Secure and document a commitment from at least one named teacher, school, or OER repository to adopt and use lesson plans produced by this project, and update affected tasks accordingly.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one named partner (teacher, school/district curriculum lead, or OER repository) provides a confirmed commitment to adopt and use lesson plans from this project.
The adoption mechanism is documented: classroom teaching vs. repository submission, how adoption evidence will be collected, and the partner's contact/confirmation on record with the maintainer.
A partner record is committed to the repo (or maintainer-held with a committed summary) capturing: partner name/org, role, adoption mechanism, confirmed plans in scope, and confirmation date/channel.
All task JSON files affected by this confirmation are updated: verifiedNeed is set to true and requestor is set to the partner's name/org for those tasks.
No partner PII (personal home address, personal phone) is committed; only the name, org, and role-appropriate contact channel.
resources: TASKS.md — note on verifiedNeed: false / requestor: TO BE SECURED
output: A committed partner-confirmation record documenting the adopting partner's name/org, adoption mechanism, scope, and confirmation — plus updated task JSON files with verifiedNeed: true and requestor set for affected tasks.
